paragraphs.text: Sachir is the innkeeper and the proprietor of the Akoum Expeditionary House of Akka Town in the Akoum Mountains of Zendikar . He is supposedly one of the greatest explorers of Akoum, even though he's lived in Affa his entire life.

Sachir encountered Chandra Nalaar as she attempted to follow the Dragon Scroll to get to the Eye of Ugin . As the proprietor of the Akoum Expeditionary House, Sachir accepted coins from Chandra and gave her guides through the various mountain passes toward the Eye. In order, he offered Chandra the services of the hydra -slayer Urdom for one gold coin, the hookslingers Mira and Tau for two gold coins, the lullmage Ilvoro for three gold coins, and the goblin Gurgel Brothers for four gold coins. Although they all perished in their attempts at bringing Chandra through the passes, the last Gurgel brother was at least successful in bringing Chandra across the Teeth of Akoum to the League of Anowon before he was eaten by a giant wurm. Sachir for his part was left with a tidy sum of ten gold coins and four available guide slots.
